dataset: EUR/NOK v2 public daily-market observations, normalized by observation month
vintage: Latest source vintage on each recorded retrieval date. Not an ALFRED/archived as-of real-time panel. Later source corrections may change historical observations.
missing_value_policy: Empty CSV fields are missing observations. No interpolation, backward fill, cross-month fill, synthetic prehistory or splice to a different dollar index. USD broad is unavailable before January 2006.
timing_policy: market.csv stores observation-month values. The model runner must apply declared source publication lags. In particular, a contemporaneous US-close or subsequently released EIA/H.10 value is not available at the same month's Norwegian 14:15 fixing.

ecb_mro_regime.rule: Use observed MRR_FR when present; otherwise use observed MRR_RT for that same day. All overlapping observations are checked for equality. No fill across the 2000-2008 fixed-rate tender gap.

fx.rights: Norges Bank public statistical data; attribute Norges Bank. Indicative reference rates, not executable quotes.
fx.name: fx

nb.rights: Norges Bank public statistical data; attribute Norges Bank.
nb.name: nb

ecb.rights: ECB public statistical data; attribute ECB and identify calculations. Source terms apply.
ecb.name: ecb

brent.publisher: US Energy Information Administration, distributed by FRED
brent.rights: EIA federal statistical data distributed by FRED; attribute EIA and FRED. Source and FRED terms apply.
brent.name: brent

vix.rights: Cboe proprietary index data; FRED public accessibility is not a blanket commercial redistribution licence. Attribute Cboe/FRED and observe source terms.
vix.name: vix

usd.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, distributed by FRED
usd.rights: Federal Reserve public statistical data distributed by FRED; attribute Board of Governors/FRED. Source and FRED terms apply.
usd.name: usd

spot_eurnok.monthly_aggregation: last nonmissing official daily observation within each calendar month
spot_eurnok.publication_availability: Daily indicative reference fixing at 14:15 CET according to source COLLECTION field; use the final observed business day of the month. This is not a closing executable transaction price.

nb_policy.monthly_aggregation: last nonmissing official daily observation within each calendar month
nb_policy.publication_availability: Official daily effective policy rate; end-of-day collection. End-month observed rate is used, not an announced future rate.

ecb_dfr.monthly_aggregation: last nonmissing official daily observation within each calendar month
ecb_dfr.publication_availability: Official daily effective deposit facility rate. Source itself includes calendar-day observations. No rate is carried beyond source coverage.

ecb_mro.monthly_aggregation: last nonmissing official daily observation within each calendar month
ecb_mro.publication_availability: Official daily effective MRO rate, combining fixed-rate and minimum-bid regimes on equal calendar dates. No rate is carried beyond source coverage.

brent.monthly_aggregation: arithmetic mean of nonmissing official daily observations
brent.publication_availability: Underlying EIA daily observations reach FRED after their observation dates; historical release timestamps are not retained here. Use a conservative one-completed-month predictor lag.

vix.monthly_aggregation: arithmetic mean of nonmissing official daily observations
vix.publication_availability: US daily closing VIX arrives after the Norwegian reference fixing; FRED ingestion may be later. Use a conservative one-completed-month predictor lag.

usd_broad.monthly_aggregation: last nonmissing official daily observation within each calendar month
usd_broad.publication_availability: Board H.10 publishes previous-week daily rates/indexes on Mondays at 16:15 US Eastern (next business day on a federal holiday). Use a conservative one-completed-month predictor lag; observation date is not publication date.
